Extract description from <meta name='description'> tag

```typescript title="TypeScript"

function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { extractMetadata: true };
  const result = convert("<html><head><title>Page</title><meta name=\"description\" content=\"This is the page description.\"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", options);
  console.log(result);
}
```
